thread:
Maya: Quick proposal - allow vuln-triage team to request timeboxed 30d SIEM extracts for investigations. Plan: automated request -> two approvers -> ephemeral KMS unseal to produce a sealed bundle. Thoughts?
Owen: 👍 need to confirm data minimization — only fields needed for triage (no PII unless justified).
Priya: Can we avoid full export? Can we do filtered forwarding to a shielded analytics tenant instead of unsealing raw logs?
Maya: Good q. For some vuln triage we need packet-level or full auth trace which isn't available in forwarder views. Hence the sealed bundle idea.
Ravi: If we go sealed bundles we should use CMK with key-access logs and automated rotation. Also require `approve_siem_extract` role in IAM audit.
Iris: I sketched a lightweight approval flow in the RFC: <https://rfc.internal/siem-access-2026|RFC: SIEM access flow> — includes 72h TTL and scoped keys.
Maya: Paste of the request payload prototype:
```json
{
  "requester": "vuln-triage@redwood",
  "dataset": "auth-traces",
  "time_window": "2026-03-18T00:00:00Z/2026-03-20T00:00:00Z",
  "fields": ["ts","user_id","ip","request_path","headers_masked"],
  "purpose": "vuln-triage",
  "justification_ticket": "INC-1234"
}
```
Owen: For KMS handshake: propose ephemeral DEKs wrapped with CMK. Approver service calls KMS:GenerateDataKeyOnce, decrypt -> stream to sealed artifact store. Audit event captured.
Priya: How do we handle oncall/investigation urgent unlocks? We need emergency path but with extra guards. Maybe require SOC lead + SRE lead second approval.
Ravi: Emergency overrides must still be logged and require post-facto blameless review. Add `emergency_unseal` guarded in IAM with alerting to SecOps channel.
Iris: Small policy snippet I drafted for RBAC (can adapt):
```hcl
resource "iam_role" "approve_siem_extract" {
  name = "approve_siem_extract"
  allowed_actions = ["kms:GenerateDataKey", "kms:Decrypt", "siem:CreateExportGrant"]
  constraints = { "mfa_required" = true }
}
```
Maya: Ops question — who will run the automation? Eng-infra or SecOps? Need SLOs for delivery (exports within 30m of approval).
Owen: Eng-infra should own automation + runbooks; SecOps owns policy and approver list.
Priya: One more: retention on sealed bundles — probably delete after 30 days unless evidence hold. Add automated purge job.
Maya: Agreed. Action items: 1) Eng-infra to prototype KMS DEK flow (Ravi + Owen), 2) SecOps to finalize approver roles and docs (Iris + Priya), 3) Create runbook + alerting for emergency unseal (Maya). I'll open a tracking ticket. :memo:
sec-bot: Created ticket SIEM-2421 for the prototype + approvals, assigned to Ravi, Owen, Iris. :white_check_mark:
Ravi: I'll start the prototype tomorrow and share a PoC repo.
Iris: I'll update RFC with the RBAC snippet and approver matrix.
Maya: Thanks all — let's triage follow-up in #eng-security tomorrow 10am PT. :eyes:
